title: Ben Webster, drink and a straight razor at the Three Deuces
summary: Drunk, Ben dumped drinks on Charlie Shavers and pulled a razor on Simmons; the bartender took it.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: So one night. Roy Eldridge and Charlie Shavers were on the bandstand at the Three Deuces jamming, and Charlie was blowing Roy off the bandstand, you know. So Ben comes in and

a white Rolls, went around in a white Rolls, Lady Day and Charlie and I were in the booth drinking. Now Charlie is sitting up against the wall in the booth by his self. And Lady Day and I are sitting over together facing Charlie. And we're facing the door and the meanwhile, Charlie's back is turn to the door.

Say oh my God, here comes Ben, he's staggering in, he can smell the bottle, he ain't had no drink, he just smell one and he's drunk. Say watch your drinks. He comes over to the table and leans over. There's my drink, Billie's drink and rakes them off and Charlie's drink and rakes them off in Charlie's lap. Well you know, naturally Charlie's reaction would be to jump up, you know, to keep them from drowning, off of -- in a hurry.

Ben grabs Charlie and pulled him out of the booth and started to slapping him around the place. I say heh, Ben, don't do that man. Say I know you, John Simmons, you ready to fight. You've been known to whip everybody. Everybody your size. I got something for you. So he come out of his handkerchief pocket in his coat with a straight edge razor. And we're standing at the bar. He say I got something for you. Well the police, plain clothesman, let their presence be known. They was fixing to rap his head with the automatic black jack, you know. But they just -- but the bartender waved him off, say heh, Ben give me the razor or get out. I'm not giving you my razor. He

start arguing. He say look, Ben, you in my premises. I can kill you right here and nothing will happen. So Ben give him the razor. He says, on second thought, get out anyway and come back and get your razor when you get off from work, you know. See you going to upset the place anyway. You've had too many to drink. And I reserve the right to refuse you, you know so go on out.
